$comment: Captured from the database the PRE-change prisma/seed.ts produced (issue #712, PP-5.5): roles, permissions and role_permissions by name, the global system_settings row, and the row counts. seed-platform.db.spec.ts proves the registry-driven seed writes exactly this. Do not regenerate it to make a test pass: when seeded data changes on purpose, edit it here in the same commit so the change shows in review. Edited on purpose by issue #723 (PP-6.3): the org_admin role, the four org_* permissions, admin's org grants moved to org_admin, and the scoped role descriptions. Edited on purpose by issue #726 (PP-6.7): the two system permissions organizations:read and organizations:write, granted to admin.

roles.name: admin
roles.description: System administrator - operate the deployment: users, roles and all system settings

roles.name: contributor
roles.description: Organization member - manage own settings and storage objects, use AI

roles.name: org_admin
roles.description: Organization administrator - everything a contributor can do, plus manage the organization members and invites

roles.name: viewer
roles.description: Read-only organization member - view content and manage own settings

permissions.name: ai:use
permissions.description: Call AI models using a saved key

permissions.name: ai_config:read
permissions.description: View the deployment-wide AI platform policy

permissions.name: ai_config:write
permissions.description: Change whether AI is enabled, the key policy, per-provider configuration and the deployment-wide defaults

permissions.name: allowlist:read
permissions.description: View allowlisted emails

permissions.name: allowlist:write

permissions.name: broadcasts:read

permissions.name: broadcasts:write

permissions.name: db_backup:read

permissions.name: jobs:read

permissions.name: jobs:write

permissions.name: nodes:read

permissions.name: nodes:write

permissions.name: org_invites:read

permissions.name: org_invites:write

permissions.name: system_settings:write

permissions.name: user_settings:write
